Cook Memorial: Policy: most programs open to cardholders and non-cardholders alike; some may be limited to CMPLD cardholders (stated on the event).
Fremont: No restriction stated on this class. Fremont marks restricted classes "Fremont cardholders only".
Warren-Newport: Policy: some programs may be restricted to WNPLD cardholders; none currently are.
Lake Villa: Everyone is welcome to register for our programs, a library card is not required.
Round Lake Area: Policy: only certain high-demand, small programs are limited to RLAPL cardholders; none currently are.
Waukegan: Policy: programs open to the public; Waukegan may require a card for a specific program.
Zion-Benton: All programs are open to the public.
Ela Area: Programs are open to the general public; cardholders may be given registration preference for high-demand programs.
Highland Park: Programs are generally open to all interested persons.
Northbrook: Policy: certain high-demand, small programs are limited to Northbrook cardholders (stated on the event). CCS patrons, including Grayslake, are already in its system.
Indian Trails: Policy: in limited circumstances registration may be limited to Indian Trails cardholders (stated on the event).
Mount Prospect: Programs open to all; cardholders may be given registration preference for high-demand programs.
Algonquin: Policy: Algonquin may require its card for a specific program (stated on the event).
